# `stat`

Helper: `stat(label, value, sub, { unit })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (plain text label/value cell) · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaCardLine` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Label (label 12, ink-soft), value (section 16/700, heading) with optional unit (small), optional sub line.

## Variants

- With or without unit
- With sub line

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

ink-soft, heading, text-label, text-section

## Do

- Use for a small summary cell inside a `grid(3, ...)`
- Keep values short (a count, a date)

## Don't

- Do not use it where a `kpis` tile fits (a top-of-page metric)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Plain text cell, no border.

## Mobile (390)

Cells stack according to the parent `grid` (`colsn`).

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Small summary cell, e.g. "Liệu trình hiện tại / Buổi đã hoàn tất" in a `grid(3, ...)`
